title: MCA Anvil Fix
description: This data pack fixes the 'tag.mca:anvils' issue in MCA Reborn (Minecraft Comes Alive Reborn).
body:
This data pack fixes the "tag.mca:anvils" issue in MCA Reborn (Minecraft Comes Alive Reborn). Simply, put this in your world's datapacks folder, enter the world and run /reload. Even though after running /reload, inside the blueprint's catalog it still says "tag.mca:anvils", if you simply go back to the map and click refresh it should detect the anvil. If it breaks and does not detect the anvil on the next load, again, just run /reload to solve it.

****Important notes
- I have no idea if this data pack works for you, for me it does work. If you click the refresh button in the blueprint too many times, there is a high chance it will revert back to not detecting the anvils. This data pack is still very experimental.
